snippet.title: Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling - Nintendo Switch Trailer
snippet.description:
Excited to share a big announcement with you: "Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling" is coming to Nintendo Switch on 29 February 2024!!! 🥳✨

Reaching this type of milestone is a real joy.

Huge thanks to our community, @jpd92363 and @rawrlabgames for making this happen! 💛
